description: Shows a C/C++ repository whose files mix Shift_JIS (CP932), UTF-8 and other encodings right: opens each file in its encoding, keeps mixenc's mirror up to date, and says only when something is wrong.
command.addRepository: Add a repository to this window
command.diagnoseDeep: Diagnose deeply (clangd on every translation unit)
command.openConfig: Open the settings file (the override table)
config.path: The mixenc executable (default: mixenc on PATH). `mixenc workspace` sets it.
config.workspace: The folder that holds mixenc.json (older; mixenc.configs replaces it).
untrusted: In a workspace you have not trusted, mixenc runs from PATH, not from the workspace's setting.
config.configs: The settings files this window uses (mixenc.json or <name>.mixenc.json, relative to the .code-workspace or absolute; one per repository is the usual). `mixenc workspace` adds them.
